subject: Verdant Labs onboarding - PO requirement & short pilot billing
messages:
From: Sara Liu <sara.liu@verdantlabs.io>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 15 Jan 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Vendor onboarding - Verdant Labs (pilot)

Hi Evelyn,

Thanks again for the product demo yesterday. Verdant Labs is excited to run a four-week pilot of Redwood Inference for our internal analytics features. Before we kick off procurement needs, can you confirm whether Redwood requires a purchase order for a short pilot? Our procurement team is asking whether we need to submit a PO up front or if we can proceed invoice-only for the first month while contracts are finalized.

Attached: Verdant_Vendor_Info.xlsx (spreadsheet)

Quick answers would help us schedule the pilot start.

Thanks,
Sara Liu
Vendor Ops | Verdant Labs
procurement@verdantlabs.io
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sara Liu <sara.liu@verdantlabs.io>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 15 Jan 2027 11:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding - Verdant Labs (pilot)

Hi Sara —

Great to meet you yesterday. Short answer: our standard is PO-first for all vendor spend, but we do allow controlled invoice-only paths for one-off pilots under certain conditions. To evaluate, we need:

- Completed vendor onboarding form (I attached a blank below)
- W-9 or equivalent tax form (if US entity)
- Invoice cadence and billing contact
- Pilot cap amount and start/end dates

If you can provide those today, I’ll loop in Finance to sign off on a one-month invoice-only exception so your pilot can start next week.

I’m cc'ing Priyom in Procurement who maintains the temporary pilot approvals.

Attachments: vendor_onboarding_form.pdf (PDF stub)

Regards,
Evelyn Hart
Sr. Manager, Customer Success Ops
Redwood Inference
From: Alex Chen <alex@verdantlabs.io>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwoodinference.com>, Sara Liu <sara.liu@verdantlabs.io>
Date: Mon, 18 Jan 2027 08:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding - Verdant Labs (pilot)

Evelyn / Priyom —

Thanks for the quick response. We attached the onboarding form and W-9. Proposed pilot: 1 month (2027-01-25 to 2027-02-24), cap $7,500, single invoice at the end of the month to accounting@verdantlabs.io. We can sign a short SOW but would like to delay DocuSign until after the pilot if possible.

Attachments: Verdant_onboarding_form_filled.pdf, Verdant_W9.pdf

Let us know if anything else is needed.

Best,
Alex
From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwoodinference.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwoodinference.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Sara Liu <sara.liu@verdantlabs.io>, Alex Chen <alex@verdantlabs.io>
Date: Mon, 18 Jan 2027 10:10:00 -0800
Subject: FWD: Vendor onboarding - Verdant Labs (pilot)

Evelyn / Markus — forwarding Verdant's completed forms. They requested invoice-only for the first month while SOW is finalized. Proposal from Verdant: one invoice at end of pilot for up to $7.5k.

Suggested controls for approval:
- One-month invoice-only exception (pilot)
- Cap at $7,500 and auto-suspend services if usage > cap
- Finance to validate payment terms (net30) and remit-to details before pilot start
- Require sign-off on SOW or purchase order for any extension beyond pilot

Please advise if Finance can approve an exception with those controls. If approved, I will confirm start date and send a mutual action plan.

Thanks,
Priyom
Procurement Lead, Redwood Inference
From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwoodinference.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwoodinference.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Sara Liu <sara.liu@verdantlabs.io>
Date: Tue, 19 Jan 2027 09:55:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding - Verdant Labs (pilot)

Hi team —

Finance can approve a one-month invoice-only path for Verdant with the following hard stops:

- Written approval recorded (attached)
- Pilot capped at $7,500; any usage forecast exceeding that will trigger immediate suspension until a PO/SOW is in place
- Payment terms: Net30 from invoice receipt; remit-to validation required before go-live
- Accounting to receive and store W-9 (received) and vendor banking details before first invoice

I’ve attached the approval memo for the record. Priyom, please add the risk controls to the onboarding checklist and confirm the automation for the cap enforcement.

Attachment: one_month_invoice_approval.pdf

-Markus
Director, Finance Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sara Liu <sara.liu@verdantlabs.io>, Alex Chen <alex@verdantlabs.io>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwoodinference.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 20 Jan 2027 15:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding - Verdant Labs (pilot)

Hi Sara / Alex —

Thanks — Finance has approved a one-month invoice-only pilot under the controls Markus outlined. Next steps to get you live on 2027-01-25:

1) Verdant returns vendor banking details and confirmation of invoice remit-to (accounting@verdantlabs.io) — required before go-live
2) Redwood will enable pilot access with a $7,500 hard cap and automatic suspend on breach
3) Verdant to send final invoice within 5 business days after pilot end (expected by 2027-02-01)
4) Procurement (Priyom) will track SOW execution; if you want the pilot extended we will require a signed SOW or PO prior to extension

Attached: onboarding_checklist.xlsx, pilot_invoice_path.pdf

Welcome aboard — looking forward to the pilot results. I’ll share a brief mutual action plan once banking details are provided.

Best,
Evelyn Hart
Sr. Manager, Customer Success Ops
Redwood Inference
